market.summary: Google DeepMind has open-sourced WeatherNext, its AI weather model that predicted hurricane tracks a day earlier than traditional systems. The code and model weights are now publicly available for use and development.

market.title: Google DeepMind’s WeatherNext 2 outperforms previous AI weather models on 99.9% of variables
market.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research released WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones, AI weather models that outperform conventional systems on 99.9% of forecast variables. The cyclone-tracking variant provides about one day of lead time over traditional forecasts, and the models are open-sourced on GitHub under an Apache 2.0 license.

market.title: Making open-source AI weather forecasting models easy to run
market.summary: Earthmover and Hugging Face provide a tutorial and demo for running open-source AI weather models like Aurora, using Earthmover's ERA5 data. The tutorial shows how to fetch initial conditions, run a 24-hour forecast, and compare against ERA5, with code available. It also covers running forecasts via Hugging Face jobs.

market.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
market.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research released WeatherNext 3, an AI weather model that predicts down to 5 km resolution and improves rain forecasts by 60% over WeatherNext 2. It will feed into Google search, Maps, and Gemini, and beats competitors on Operational WeatherBench. The model ingests hourly satellite data, aiming for higher-resolution global forecasts.

market.title: Google DeepMind unveils WeatherNext model that could reshape crypto prediction markets and DeFi insurance
market.summary: Google DeepMind has developed WeatherNext 2, an advanced weather forecasting model capable of predicting hurricanes with higher accuracy than traditional methods up to 15 days in advance. The model's open-source availability enables integration into crypto prediction markets and DeFi insurance protocols to enhance real-time weather data usage.
